title: BALAMINES — Trade Brief · 03 Jun 2026
catalyst: A sharp, margin-led earnings turn — Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin jumped to ~24% (from ~19%) and PAT rose 58% YoY — validated the amine up-cycle just as Balaji commenced commercial output at India's first 1,00,000-TPA Dimethyl Ether (DME) plant on 20 May 2026, igniting a +128%/3-month re-rating to all-time highs.
